description: Update PRs for the KiBot image (kibot_settings.yaml) and the GitHub Actions. The PR check generates the outputs with the new version: compare them before merging.

customManagers.description: KiBot docker image pinned in kibot_settings.yaml

packageRules.description: Tags KIBOT-BUILD_kKICAD_dDEBIAN_bBLENDER: order by KiBot version, KiCad 10.0.x patch, then image build (reset for each KiCad version). KiCad 10.1+ changes the file formats: not proposed, migrate manually. dev_ tags are ignored.
prBodyNotes: Check the outputs of the PR run (pull request comment and artifacts) before merging: the new KiBot/KiCad version may change them.
